text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic wardrobe product photograph. Pure white seamless background and soft neutral studio lighting. No person, skin, body parts, visible mannequin or stand. Entire objects visible, faithful texture. 银色双层小吊坠项链。仅此单件配饰，成对耳饰或手套作为一组，无其他物品。
original_prompt: Edit this layered silver necklace product photo. Replace the cross pendant with a tiny simple round silver disc pendant. Add a second tiny round silver disc pendant at the center of the shorter chain. Exactly two delicate silver chain layers, each with one tiny circular disc. No cross, no heart, no flower. Preserve white background and fine silver chain material.
